entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Planeswalker and Boros ally who splits his time between fighting the Eldrazi on Zendikar and a goblin gang war on Ravnica, pushing himself to exhaustion.

entities.name: Munda
entities.description: A broad kor warrior and Gideon's friend, nicknamed the Spider for trapping Eldrazi with ropes.

entities.name: Dars Gostok
entities.description: A captain in the Boros Legion who works with Gideon on the goblin gang war.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A goblin criminal kingpin of Ravnica, blamed for murdering Dargig, whom Gideon captures.

entities.name: Rikkig
entities.description: One of the Shattergang Brothers, a goblin bomb-maker who holds prisoners and escapes Gideon.

entities.name: Gardagig
entities.description: One of the Shattergang Brothers who gave up the location of the hideout.

entities.name: Dargig
entities.description: The youngest Shattergang Brother and a black market explosives runner whose murder started the gang war.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A merfolk escort who survived Bala Ged and carries Kendrin's research on the leylines puzzle.

entities.name: Kendrin
entities.description: An Eldrazi expert who was on the brink of a discovery about the leylines and the Eye, and dies at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Commander Vorik
entities.description: The Zendikari commander who ordered the evacuation of Sea Gate.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: A Zendikari leader whose band escorts the Bala Ged survivors.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: The Living Guildpact and Planeswalker whom Gideon decides to seek out for help.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A world ravaged by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild-ruled plane where a goblin gang war endangers the unguilded.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Otherworldly monsters devastating Zendikar.

entities.name: The Boros Legion
entities.description: The disciplined guild of soldiers with which Gideon allies on Ravnica.

entities.name: The Shattergang Brothers
entities.description: Goblin explosives-makers who declare war on Krenko and threaten the Boros.

entities.name: The kor
entities.description: A people of Zendikar who paint hedron designs on their bodies and fight the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: A continent of Zendikar overrun and destroyed by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Sejiri
entities.description: A place on Zendikar previously destroyed by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The largest settlement on Zendikar, built on a white dam, overrun by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Chamber of the Guildpact
entities.description: The Ravnican seat of the Living Guildpact where Gideon collapses at the foot of the steps.

entities.name: The hedrons
entities.description: Eight-faced monolithic stones to which the Eldrazi react and which the Zendikari use as wards.

entities.name: Gideon's sural
entities.description: Gideon's weapon of four ribbon-like metal blades.

events.summary: Gideon kills an Eldrazi monstrosity on Zendikar with a shard of hedron after a hard fight.
Munda and his band find Gideon and tell him that Bala Ged has been overrun and destroyed.
events.quote: Bala Ged, the entire continent, has be overrun and destroyed.

events.summary: Flashback: Gideon and Dars watch Foundry Street burn in a goblin gang war that began with Dargig's murder.
events.quote: It was the Shattergang way of declaring war.

events.summary: Gideon brings the captured Krenko, stabbed twice in the leg, to the Boros garrison.
events.quote: "And I come bearing gifts," said Gideon

events.summary: A canister lands in the garrison with a note from the Shattergang Brothers threatening Boros territory unless Krenko is handed over.
events.quote: Turn him over to us, or we will reduce Boros territory to rubble.

events.summary: Gideon holds a canyon pass against Eldrazi spawn while survivors from Bala Ged escape.
events.quote: Gideon planted himself in the narrow path

events.summary: A mage collapses the cliffs with lightning along Munda's iron spikes, burying the Eldrazi spawn.
events.quote: sheets of white stone tumbled toward the Eldrazi below.

events.summary: Munda tells Gideon a great host of Eldrazi descends on Sea Gate.
events.quote: "A great host of Eldrazi descends on Sea Gate."

events.summary: Gideon storms the Shattergang hideout, fights Rikkig and survives his bomb; Rikkig escapes while Gideon and Dars free prisoners.
events.quote: "The Boros didn't take Krenko. I did. Just like I got your brother. And now I'm here for you."

events.summary: The Eldrazi overwhelm Sea Gate and pin Gideon under a beam until he frees himself.
events.quote: the Eldrazi swept in from both sides of the sea wall.

events.summary: Gideon meets the merfolk Jori En carrying her dead companion Kendrin, who had been on the brink of a discovery about leylines and the Eye.
events.quote: Kendrin was on the brink of a discovery.

events.summary: Gideon concludes Sea Gate is lost and that Kendrin's leylines puzzle is a possible answer, and he needs another expert.
events.quote: Fighting to avoid something was not the same as fighting for something.

events.summary: Gideon rides an Eldrazi off the sea wall into the sea, then planeswalks to Ravnica.
events.quote: In a tangle of tendrils, Gideon fell with it.

events.summary: Gideon arrives in Ravnica at the Chamber of the Guildpact, intending to ask Jace for help, and collapses on the steps.
events.quote: Gideon ascended the first step, tried for another, but gravity had him, and he collapsed.

relations.quote: You didn't have to do this alone, Gideon.
a captain in the Boros Legion
That grinning stain stuck a shiv in my leg.
the goblin criminal kingpin, Krenko, did the deed himself
"You're not safe to do anything, Rikkig, unless you come with me right now."
Like so many others Gideon had battled these last few weeks
I was her escort on her expeditions
